about: Photos of an artist's work for ArtistGallery, in a booth's sheet. Only photos the artist has given permission for, sent by the artist or taken at the festival with their OK; never copied from an artist's website or social accounts. Keyed by booth number as the market chair numbers them (booth-numbering-2026.json); re-check the keys after any re-pull, because the chair renumbers. A booth with no entry shows no gallery: the sheet stays complete without it.

<booth number>.src: /artist-photos/<booth>-<n>.jpg (the file goes in public/artist-photos/; about 1200px on the long side)
<booth number>.alt: what the photo shows, for screen readers: the work, not the filename
<booth number>.permission: who said yes, and when (e.g. 'artist, email to fallfestvolunteers@, 2026-11-20')
